mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each UBO/director/shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or licensed bank in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and professional reference letter
Certified Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft) for corporate shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory real-time screening against UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK/HM Treasury, EU and Vanuatu Domestic Sanctions List; enhanced due diligence for PEPs with source of wealth/source of funds verification and senior management approval; counterparty / correspondent bank vetting for money transmission rails; FATF Recommendation 6-8 compliance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Name Reservation / e-portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English and French are official languages; company names must be in Latin characters; names in other scripts must be transliterated/romanized into English or French before submission; numerals and punctuation allowed per VFSC guidelines.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 calendar days of the VFSC rejection notice, the applicant or the licensed registered agent must file a written appeal with the VFSC Registry (appeal fee payable) stating factual grounds and proposed modifications; if the name is identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name, the appeal will generally fail unless the existing holder's written consent is attached; a revised name can be reserved without prejudice after final rejection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for a licensed money transmission/remittance entity; a physical registered office and a place of business in Vanuatu are mandatory, and the provincial business license requires a local operational address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (estimated 70% probability of an unannounced VFSC/examiner physical inspection within the first 12 months of licensing)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Act No. 32 of 1992), Part II (ss. 3-8, registration and certificate of incorporation), ss. 18-24 (shares and capital), ss. 25-33 (registered office and officers); International Companies Regulation 1993, regs. 3-6; Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap 70] s. 6 (licence precondition for regulated activity).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), 1st Floor, Bouffa Point, Taser Piki Road, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with the prescribed Application for Registration of an International Company (VFSC Form IC-2) submitted through a VFSC-licensed registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required. The standard charter provides for 100 ordinary shares of US$ 1.00 each; one or more shares may be issued fully or partly paid. No escrow deposit, bank guarantee, or capital attestation is required by the Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: UNANIMOUS WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS of the Vanuatu International Company [Company Name] Ltd. RESOLVED: (1) the Memorandum and Articles of Association be adopted as the Company's founding charter; (2) 100 ordinary shares of par value US$ 1.00 each be allotted to the subscriber; (3) the registered office be fixed at the licensed registered agent's office, Port Vila, Vanuatu; (4) the persons named in the appointment annex be appointed as the first Directors and Corporate Secretary; and (5) the Directors be authorised to file all applications and execute all instruments required to obtain a Vanuatu Financial Dealer Licence for cross-border remittance services.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Name Reservation Counter (acting through a VFSC-licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two ranked company name preferences through the agent. The agent verifies name availability on the VFSC system, confirms the registered agent licence status, and pays the prescribed name reservation fee. The subscriber must provide proof of identity and proof of address; the agent countersigns under Regulation 4 of the International Companies Regulation 1993.
required_dossiers: IC Name Reservation Application Form
Validated VFSC Registered Agent Consent Letter
Certified copy of passport of subscriber and first director
Proof of residential address of subscriber
Name reservation fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for being misleading, objectionable, or identical to an existing entity, file a fresh application with two alternative names; if the refusal resulted from a registry error, the fee is credited to the new application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting of Constitutional Documents by Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (on behalf of the Registrar of International Companies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English. Confirm that the objects clause expressly includes cross-border money transmission and remittance agency services and that the prohibited-activity provisions exclude onshore Vanuatu business. Have the subscriber and first director execute the charter and consents before a witness or notary public.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Share Subscription Agreement
Director Consent to Act Form
Registered Office Consent Letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend the draft to address any preliminary comments made by the Registrar and re-file through the same registered agent at no additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing with VFSC Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The agent lodges the signed charter and Form IC-2 at the VFSC registry counter or via the agent's submission portal, attaching the paid fee receipt, registered office consent, and director consents. The Registrar examines compliance with Part II of the International Companies Act and issues a Certificate of Incorporation upon approval.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (original)
Application for Registration of International Company (Form IC-2)
Registered Office Declaration
Director and Secretary Consents
State filing fee receipt (US$ 200)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to a Notice of Query within 21 calendar days with corrected or supplementary documents; resubmission through the agent attracts no additional government fee where the query is raised within 14 days of the original filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Certificate of Incorporation and Registry Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory filing, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation. Instruct the agent to order certified registry abstracts, a certificate of good standing, and share certificates. Verify the corporate name, registered office, share capital, and officer entries appearing on the Registry extract. Retain the Certificate of Incorporation as the principal title document.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certified Register of Members and Directors
Certificate of Good Standing (optional)
Certificate of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Apply in writing for a certified duplicate or rectification of the certificate under section 34 of the International Companies Act; the Registry issues a replacement within two working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal, Share Certificates, and Officer Recordal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary acting through the VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first directors' meeting in writing, approve the form of common seal, issue the subscribed shares, open the statutory registers, and resolve to procure the relevant remittance licence. The Secretary then files the resolution, registers share transfers if any, and prepares the KYB package for corporate bank account opening.
required_dossiers: Board Resolution approving seal and share issue
Share Certificates
Statutory Register of Directors and Officers
Corporate bank account opening application and KYB package
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify register discrepancies by supplemental board resolution; re-issue lost share certificates and evidence Board authority to the bank with an updated certificate of incumbency.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Financial Dealers Licensing Division, in coordination with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit for AML supervision
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Financial Dealer Licence (Cross-Border Money Transmission and Remittance Services), granted under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap 70] read with the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2016; the licence scope is offshore and non-resident facing, with onshore Vanuatu-facing remittance excluded for an International Company.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and Disaster Management, Republic of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Exempt / Registration-only. The licensed activity involves no physical construction, industrial processing, effluent discharge, or emission source, so no Environmental Impact Assessment report is required. A simple activity registration applies only if the operator maintains a physical local administrative office.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to licensed remittance activity; no wastewater or VOC discharge standards are imposed. General office waste must be deposited at a licensed municipal landfill under the Vanuatu Waste Management Act, and e-waste from office hardware must be handled by authorised recyclers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For any physically occupied office, a Fire Safety Compliance Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Services and an occupancy and structural clearance from the Port Vila Municipal Council are required. Where the International Company operates from the registered agent's licensed premises, the agent's existing fire and occupancy clearances suffice. No special civil defence authorisation or dangerous-goods storage licence applies to a money transmission and remittance business.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) of the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; electronic portal: Vanuatu Electronic Single Window / ASYCUDA World and gov.vu online services
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from Vanuatu income tax and therefore does not pursue a national income-tax TIN. Establishment is effected through a licensed VFSC registered agent: (i) reserve and file the IC's memorandum and articles under the International Companies Act; (ii) obtain the Certificate of Incorporation/Registration issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; and (iii) if the IC will supply taxable supplies in Vanuatu or import/export dutiable goods, apply through the DCIR for a VAT registration number/customs owner code and such number is stated on all VAT invoices. The Certificate of Incorporation and VFSC annual filing receipt are the primary fiscal identifiers for banks and counterparties.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Vanuatu law for an IC; all ICs are automatically non-resident, tax-exempt entities. An IC can be re-domiciled/continued as a locally formed company under the Companies Act, but that conversion is a legal entity-action and does not constitute an elective tax classification. In foreign jurisdictions, the IC may be transparent or opaque by the foreign rules, but such treatment has no domestic Vanuatu election consequence.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) as established by the Value Added Tax Act; also customs and excise duties are applied by the Customs Act
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Vt 5,000,000 (approx. USD 43,000) of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period; voluntary registration is available to persons making exclusively zero-rated supplies
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime is imposed on VAT invoices. Import/export declarations are cleared electronically via the Vanuatu Customs ASYCUDA World system. VAT invoices must be computer-generated or manual and retained for at least 7 years; registered remittance agents are expected to maintain SWIFT MT103/MT202 records and local cash-pickup settlement files. There is no statutory API-connect mandate to an e-invoicing platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for zero-rating when a VAT-registered supplier exports tangible goods directly to a non-resident buyer outside Vanuatu and retains proof of export. Services (including cross-border remittance/clearing services) qualify as zero-rated exported services when provided to a non-resident principal and not performed for a benefit consumed within Vanuatu; financial intermediation fees in connection with the transfer of funds from a non-resident remitter to a Vanuatu beneficiary may be treated as non-taxable exempt financial services or zero-rated if the supply is concluded on the non-resident's account and the remuneration is not attributable to Vanuatu activities. The IC must hold written service agreements, SWIFT advice, interbank charges, and the banking end-user attestation demonstrating that the principal is abroad.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading/Airway Bill or equivalent transport document for goods; SWIFT MT103/MT202 and clearing-house settlement reports for remittance services
Inward Remittance Certificate from the VFSC-licensed bank or foreign-bank correspondent
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unjustified zero-rating causes disallowance of the zero-rate and output VAT at 12.5% plus penalties: a 10% late-payment fine, monthly interest of 1.5% or such statutory rate, and criminal fines up to Vt 1,000,000 with imprisonment for tax evasion. Input VAT credits may be retrospectively clawed back from prior returns (generally a three-year assessment window extended indefinitely for fraud). DCIR reconciles export declarations, shipping evidence, bank SWIFT/repatriation receipts and beneficiary-cash pickup records; remittance agents that cannot produce the inward remittance certificate and FX repatriation evidence will have the VAT zero-rating reversed and may be removed from the money-transfer licence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 286] (1989), exercises central banking, banking supervision, and exchange administration functions. The Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU), embedded within the RBV, supervises reporting institutions under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2002 [Cap. 270]. Money changers and money transmitters are regulated by the RBV under the Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 63] and the Financial Dealers (Money Changers and Money Transmitters) Regulations (Order No. 44 of 2001), which constitute the licensing regime for cross-border remittance service providers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a fully liberalized exchange system: the vatu (VUV) is freely convertible on both current and capital account, the Republic has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, and there are no exchange-control approvals, surrender requirements, or restrictions on dividend, interest, royalty, or capital repatriation by International Companies. The de facto constraints are operational: VUV is thinly traded, the commercial market is concentrated in two major banks, and large FX conversions require 48-hour lead time and are executed against a managed float maintained by the RBV. Profit remittance is subject only to standard bank documentary review (audited financial statements) and, where applicable, the money transmitter's segregated client funds rule.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu imposes no mandatory repatriation period, no conversion percentage, and no surrender obligation for export proceeds or remittance receipts. All receivables may be held in any convertible currency in offshore, onshore, or foreign bank accounts indefinitely. For remittance operators, RBV license conditions require that customer funds be segregated in a designated client money/trust account; settlement to beneficiaries must be executed within standard T+1 to T+2 commercial terms, and transactions at or above VT 1,000,000 are reportable to the VFIU as currency/threshold transaction reports.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (Vanuatu) Limited (BSP Vanuatu, successor to Westpac Vanuatu)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Onshore treasury: multi-currency Operational Account (VUV/USD) for remittance clearing; separate segregated Client Trust Account if the RBV money transmitter license is held by a domestic affiliate
Operational USD/VUV current account with SWIFT (ANZBVUVX) connectivity; redundant cross-border clearing rail
Local VUV settlement and cash payout agent account; suited to domestic payout network but limited offshore wiring appetite for International Companies
Operational VUV/EUR account; European parent group risk policy reduces appetite for money service business clients

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium. Following removal of Vanuatu from FATF increased monitoring (June 2024), VU International Companies are in principle acceptable to tier-2 electronic money institutions (e.g., Currenxie, Airwallex, Dukascopy), but a money-transmission business model triggers hard MSB restrictions: EMIs reserve the right to decline remittance corridors, prohibit aggregated payouts, cap monthly throughput, and terminate on transactional velocity grounds. Legally, an EMI cannot access the VUV domestic clearing rails, cash payout agent network, or VFIU-aligned trust account structure; it can serve only as a supplementary USD/EUR/GBP SWIFT collection rail, never as the primary treasury bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Vanuatu law does not mandate physical board attendance for account opening; however, the FTR Act and institutional risk policy require full identity verification of all directors, signatories, and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs). In practice remote onboarding is accepted by BSP and ANZ where (i) the IC is introduced by a licensed Registered Service Agent (RSA) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; (ii) the RSA delivers a certificate of incumbency, register of members, and beneficial ownership schedule; (iii) directors complete a live video interview with a treasury compliance officer; and (iv) passport, proof of residence, and corporate documents are certified by a notary or Vanuatu consular officer. Absent an RSA introduction, first-time foreign directors are typically requested to attend an in-person interview at Port Vila.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: MSB/money-transmitter categorization: account functionally routes third-party funds, triggering enhanced due diligence and possible de-risking
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RBV money transmitter license or written in-principle approval; VFIU registration; board-approved AML/CFT compliance manual; independent annual compliance audit; client money trust accounting opinion; transaction monitoring and sanctions screening configuration (World-Check); corridor risk assessment for each payout jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity and legacy bearer-share concerns for International Companies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date negative certificate and no-bearer-share declaration (bearer shares have been prohibited for ICs since 2012); certified register of members and directors per IC Act ss. 36-38; RSA-verified beneficial ownership schedule (25%+ threshold); source-of-wealth and source-of-funds affidavit for each UBO; external legal opinion confirming corporate existence and good standing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/PEP or prohibited-corridor flags on remittance destinations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent PEP and sanctions screening results for all UBOs, directors, counterparties, and agent banks; written corridor rationale; negative confirmation that no OFAC/EU/UN-sanctioned entities are serviced; ongoing transactional and counterparty due diligence refresh policy and training log.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unsubstantiated initial capital injection or anticipated high-velocity fund flows inconsistent with declared business
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve-month bank statements of contributing shareholder; board resolution and subscription agreement detailing funding; notarized source-of-funds letter; audited/management financial projections showing remittance throughput; explicit exclusion of crypto, gambling, and third-party pass-through activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all injections as straight-through SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own corporate/incumbency-backed account to the IC's operating account at BSP Vanuatu (BOSPVUVT) or ANZ Vanuatu (ANZBVUVX). Reference the payment with 'Share capital subscription - board resolution [date/number]' to avoid unstructured-name screening false positives. Vanuatu has no statutory purpose-code system, but the bank will apply ISO 20022 purpose description 'Equity injection/operational funding' on the customer profile; any transfer equal to or above VT 1,000,000 (or its FX equivalent) requires the bank to file a threshold transaction report with the VFIU, so preserve the full funding dossier including bank statements, resolution, and source-of-wealth declarations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Beneficiary bank payouts use SWIFT MT103 with full remitter name/address and transactional reference to satisfy FATF Recommendation 16 'travel rule' data exchange. Commercial letters of credit are inappropriate for remittance float and are reserved for physical trade financing; for cash-pickup corridors the operator aggregates payouts to licensed local agents or a money-transfer aggregator, funding agent floats from the segregated client trust account daily via the domestic VUV interbank clearing system at RBV and settling agent balances on T+1. All outbound transactions must be matched against the destination corridor policy and negative lists before release.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/VUV currency forwards with BSP, ANZ, or authorized financial dealers
USD/VUV non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) settled in USD against the RBV reference mid-rate for offshore counterparties
USD/VUV and USD/EUR cross-currency swaps with licensed commercial banks
Vanilla USD/VUV FX options for corridor floor/ceiling protection
FX margin and tom/next swap facilities booked under the Financial Dealers Act with an authorized money-changer dealer

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Government Fee for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of 10% of the annual levy per month or part thereof; continued non-payment for 3 months following a written notice triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of Financial Dealer's Licence for Cross-Border Remittance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 December, with renewal applications accepted from 1 October
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic lapse on 1 January if unrenewed; operating without a licence is a criminal offence subject to fine of up to VT 5,000,000 and/or 12 months' imprisonment; VFSC may suspend or revoke the licence and impose restitution orders.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements and Compliance Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of the financial year end (31 March for a 31 December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly penalty of VT 50,000 for late filing; refusal to renew the money transmission licence until statements are submitted; persistent non-compliance may lead to licence revocation and director disqualification.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for every VFSC-licensed money transmission or remittance operator, irrespective of revenue or asset thresholds; unlicensed International Companies are exempt unless shareholders representing at least 10% of voting rights request an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by IASB; VFSC may permit IFRS for SMEs for licensees with turnover below VT 30 million on a case-by-case prior approval basis.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must update the beneficial ownership register within 14 days of any transfer; annually, as part of the International Company Annual Return, a confirmation statement of shareholding and UBOs must be filed. The confirmation must list every individual with 25% or more direct/indirect ownership, voting rights, or ultimate control. Approved transfers remain ineffective until the register of members is updated; false confirmation is an offence.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$300 - US$800 per annum depending on agent and service level
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,000 - US$6,000 per annum depending on transaction volume and jurisdictional coverage

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax. An International Company (IC) licensed as a cross-border remittance operator is fully tax-exempt on worldwide business income. Harmonies are unnecessary; the only indirect tax relevant to local supplies is VAT at 12.5%, and remittance/financial intermediation fees are typically exempt or zero-rated as financial services. No tax losses can arise because there is no taxable income; therefore no loss carryforward exists.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return and accompanying annual fee statement lodged through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Company Registry portal. No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the International Company's incorporation date, or such earlier date as specified by VFSC in the annual fee notice.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, registration number, and date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact VFSC-registered English name; non-resident owners may provide foreign correspondence addresses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address and registered agent identity in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be the VFSC-licensed agent's physical Vanuatu address; a PO Box is insufficient. Non-resident entities must engage a Vanuatu-licensed registered agent.
List non-resident shareholders and beneficial owners; beneficial ownership particulars must be recorded for VFSC AML/CFT supervision.
Non-resident directors are permitted; enclose passport/ID copies, residential address proof, and a signed acceptance of appointment.
State 'Cross-border consumer money transmission and remittance services (ISIC 6619)' and attach the Financial Dealer's Licence issued by VFSC.
A non-resident-managed IC must still satisfy Vanuatu economic substance requirements if it performs a relevant activity; the registered agent must countersign the declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts VFSC late fees, suspension of the Certificate of Good Standing, and progressive late penalties on the annual government licence fee. Continued default leads to registry strike-off and restoration costs. Filing a knowingly false annual return is a statutory offence carrying director fines and imprisonment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (VAT form) filed electronically through the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VCIR) online portal by any IC registered for VAT in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than 30 days after the end of the relevant tax period; the final quarter closes the taxpayer's fiscal year for annual reconciliation purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total value of taxable supplies and output VAT at 12.5%
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs must register and file VAT only on supplies with a Vanuatu place of supply; exported remittance-processing services are generally zero-rated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt and out-of-scope supplies (financial services, remittance fees)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remittance transmission and settlement fees are normally exempt financial services. State only the exempt amount; foreign-sourced fees are out of scope.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Input tax credit claimed on Vanuatu-sourced purchases
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs may claim input credits only for Vanuatu-sourced costs attributable to taxable supplies; foreign head-office charges are not creditable in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net VAT payable or refund amount
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a refund is claimed, the non-resident IC must hold a Vanuatu bank account and submit underlying tax invoices to VCIR upon request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration and signature by director, officer, or registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may e-sign using VCIR digital credentials; the Vanuatu registered agent may alternatively lodge and sign under a board resolution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VAT return lodgement triggers a fixed late penalty plus daily continuing penalties; late VAT payment attracts interest and an automatic percentage surcharge. Fraudulent evasion may be prosecuted criminally with fines and imprisonment, and repeated defaults lead to VAT deregistration and licence review.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and no comprehensive double taxation agreement network. There is therefore no domestic withholding tax to reduce and no Vanuatu tax residency certificate procedure for dividends. A non-resident shareholder needing evidence of Vanuatu corporate existence may obtain from VFSC a Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing; foreign tax authorities will apply their own rules for foreign tax credit, not a Vanuatu DTA claim form.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0% for royalties and interest paid by an International Company to non-residents; treaty rate not applicable because no Vanuatu DTA is in force. Vanuatu imposes no stamp duty or withholding tax on cross-border interest, royalty, or fee remittances.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No threshold applies (VUV 0 / not applicable). Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing documentation, master-file, or local-file legislation because it levies no corporate income tax. Foreign tax authorities may nevertheless require TP records under their own laws when the Vanuatu IC is a controlled overseas entity.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR), enacted through the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act and VFSC guidance, require an International Company carrying on a relevant activity to demonstrate substance proportionate to its income. A licensed cross-border remittance business is likely to fall within the 'Financing or Leasing' category insofar as it provides money transmission, settlement, or liquidity management, or within 'Headquarters' or 'Distribution and Service Centre' if it performs intragroup processing activities. The IC must be managed and directed in Vanuatu, maintain a physical office, employ adequate full-time staff, and incur operating expenditure in Vanuatu proportionate to its revenue. An annual economic substance notification/return must be filed with VFSC; non-compliance leads to financial penalties and automatic exchange of information with the tax authorities of the entity's ultimate beneficial owners.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly failing to register for VAT when cross-border remittance fees have a Vanuatu place of supply, under-declaring transaction turnover, issuing false invoices, or destroying financial records to conceal stampable transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to VUV 5,000,000 plus 100% penalty on the tax shortfall and interest; imprisonment up to 5 years; asset seizure; deregistration from VCIR; publication of assessments and director disqualification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns or direct evasion are jointly and severally liable for unpaid VAT, interest, and penalties. Civil restitution, travel bans pending collection proceedings, and custodial sentences apply; the corporate veil is pierced for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Money Remittance / Financial Dealer Offence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a cross-border remittance rail, SWIFT payment hub, cash pickup network, or foreign-exchange settlement service without a VFSC Financial Dealer's Licence, or abusing an International Company to conduct domestic money services outside the licensed scope.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap. 262], summary conviction attracts fines up to VUV 2,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 2 years; on indictment, fines up to VUV 10,000,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years. VFSC may freeze settlement bank accounts, revoke the IC's licence, and order restitution to affected remitters.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors are personally liable for intercepted funds, subject to personal fines, account freezing orders, travel bans, and imprisonment. Where the company is a mere façade, the court will disregard limited liability and enter judgments against the directors personally.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Vanuatu International Company with no physical office, employees, or management in Vanuatu while conducting a high-volume remittance business; filing a false economic substance self-assessment; using nominee directors and undisclosed beneficial owners to conceal the settlement rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may impose administrative penalties from VUV 1,000,000 to VUV 10,000,000 per relevant activity; continuing offences incur daily fines, licence revocation, and strike-off. The economic substance file is automatically exchanged with foreign tax authorities, exposing the group to joint audits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee and real directors are jointly liable for false substance declarations and all resulting liabilities. Travel bans, confiscation of corporate records, director disqualification, and imprisonment for knowingly misleading VFSC may follow; the corporate veil is pierced because the shell lacks substantive business reality.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to conduct customer due diligence on senders and recipients, omitting source-of-funds checks, ignoring counterparty VFSC licence verification on Swift cash-pickup corridors, failing to report suspicious transactions, breaching the travel rule, or allowing bearer-share ownership of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2014, reporting entities are liable to fines of up to VUV 20,000,000 and officers to imprisonment up to 15 years. The VFSC may suspend or cancel the Financial Dealer's Licence, confiscate assets, and require disgorgement of fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face personal criminal liability if they knowingly permit AML/CFT failures. Remedies include civil asset forfeiture, freezing of foreign and local accounts, travel bans pending trial, disqualification, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Misdirection and Misappropriation of Client Funds
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Commingling consumer remittance float with operating accounts, investing client funds without authorisation, failing to pay out on the contracted value date, running Ponzi-style settlement, or soliciting remittances while insolvent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil liability for full restitution plus punitive damages; criminal fraud penalties up to VUV 10,000,000 and imprisonment up to 12 years; court-ordered winding up, receivership over accounts, and prohibition orders against the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable to trace and return misappropriated remitter funds. Courts pierce the veil where funds were diverted through related companies; personal bankruptcy, travel bans, director disqualification, and custodial sentences apply.
